both.name: dokuha-userscript
both.description: Saves a book from the BookWalker viewer, the CMOA speed reader, the ebookjapan reader, the Kindle web manga reader or the k-manga viewer as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched from the store and unscrambled offline. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: One script, five stores. The panel, its controls, the Mokuro bridge, the
reading-stat cards, the ZIP naming and the headless automation API are shared
verbatim; only the store-specific protocol lives in its own module under
src/sites/. Only the readers are matched; BookWalker stays the fallback for a
host no store owns, such as a bare injected copy.

bookwalker.name: BookWalker Native Downloader
bookwalker.description: Saves a book from the BookWalker viewer as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched from the CDN and unscrambled offline. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: BookWalker only, built from the same shared core as the CMOA script. It
matches nothing outside bookwalker.jp and does not carry a single line of
CMOA code. Install this OR the combined script, never both: they match the
same hosts and you would get two panels.

cmoa.name: CMOA Native Downloader
cmoa.description: Saves a book from the CMOA speed reader as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched from the CDN and unscrambled offline. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: CMOA only, built from the same shared core as the BookWalker script. It
matches nothing outside the CMOA readers and does not carry a single line of
BookWalker code. Install this OR the combined script, never both: they match
the same hosts and you would get two panels.

ebookjapan.name: ebookjapan Native Downloader
ebookjapan.description: Saves a book from the ebookjapan viewer as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched from the CDN and unscrambled in the browser. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: One script, one store. The panel, its controls, the Mokuro bridge, the reading-stat
cards, the ZIP naming and the headless automation API are the shared core; the
ebookjapan protocol — its pinned wasm core, the canvas realm ladder and the page
descrambler — lives in src/sites/ebookjapan/.

kindle.name: Kindle Native Downloader
kindle.description: Saves a book from the Kindle web manga reader as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched from the signed CDN and decrypted in the browser. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: One script, one store. The panel, its controls, the Mokuro bridge, the reading-stat
cards, the ZIP naming and the headless automation API are the shared core; the Kindle
protocol — the render-window walk, the ustar bundle reader and the page cipher —
lives in src/sites/kindle/.

kmanga.name: k-manga Native Downloader
kmanga.description: Saves a book from the k-manga viewer as a ZIP or CBZ of full-resolution page images, fetched over the viewer's own WebSocket and unscrambled in the browser. Optional Japanese OCR through mokuro-bridge, with upload to MEGA, Google Drive or OneDrive.
banner: One script, one store. The panel, its controls, the Mokuro bridge, the reading-stat
cards, the ZIP naming and the headless automation API are the shared core; the
k-manga protocol — the BCP000 viewer socket, the LCG block permutation and the
canvas descrambler — lives in src/sites/kmanga/.
